description_en: Checks whether a service-linked role (SLR) is created
description_zh: 该接口用于查看是否已创建服务关联角色（SLR）
kebab_example: aliyun rds check-service-linked-role --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-linked-role AliyunServiceRoleForRdsPgsqlOnEcs --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckServiceLinkedRole

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can specify any region for this parameter, which does not affect your query results. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
该参数不影响查询结果，配置任意地域即可，您可以通过DescribeRegions接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The SLR name.

For more information about the SLRs supported by ApsaraDB RDS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342840.html
parameters.help_zh:
服务关联角色。
RDS支持的服务关联角色，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342840.html
parameters.name: service_linked_role

HasServiceLinkedRole.description_en: Indicates whether an SLR is created
HasServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 是否已经创建服务关联角色（SLR）

RequireServiceLinkedRole.description_en: Indicates whether the service-linked role is required. Default value: true
RequireServiceLinkedRole.description_zh: 当前场景下是否需要该服务关联角色（默认为true）
